The candidate must be technically strong, structured, presentable, and capable of taking ownership of IT matters, coordinating with vendors and internal teams, and following issues through until closure. IT Infrastructure & Server Support Support and maintain core IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, network devices, endpoints, and related IT services. Maintain system records, configuration details, support contacts, and escalation paths. Identify recurring technical issues and recommend permanent fixes where possible. 2. Network & Wi-Fi Operations Support and troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, firewalls, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, IP addressing, ports, and connectivity-related issues. Maintain network documentation including device details, IP plans, access points, firewall dependencies, and connectivity records. IT Security, Access & Procedures Support network and system security practices, including user access management, permissions, password policies, MFA, endpoint protection, and secure access procedures. Track vendor commitments, timelines, service visits, pending actions, and closure status. Validate vendor fixes before closing issues. Property Technology Support Good-to-have / coordination responsibility Support coordination with vendors for connected property and operational systems where required. Good understanding of LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, firewalls, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, IP addressing, and connectivity troubleshooting. Experience with Windows/Linux servers, patching, backup coordination, monitoring, and basic system administration. Experience with endpoint management, device control, IT assets, and user access procedures. Understanding of MDM, device policies, access restrictions, remote wipe, app control, and endpoint compliance. Good understanding of IT security practices, user permissions, MFA, endpoint protection, access control, and offboarding procedures. Strong documentation, reporting, and follow-up discipline. Ability to manage vendors and ensure issues are tracked until closure. Ability to troubleshoot logically across network, server, device, user, vendor, and configuration layers. Professional communication skills and ability to coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and management. Strong ownership mindset and ability to work in a structured manner. Good to Have Experience in hospitality, luxury venues, smart buildings, or property technology environments. Exposure to CCTV, IPTV, IP telephony, access control, smart locks, BMS, GRMS, PMS, AV systems, conference systems, LED screens, and digital signage. Experience with Microsoft 365 / Office 365 administration, Azure AD / Entra ID, Active Directory, GPOs, IAM, or RBAC. Experience with backup tools, disaster recovery checks, NAS/storage systems, and restore testing. Experience with ticketing systems, ITIL processes, SLA reporting, RCA documentation, and preventive maintenance planning. Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar. Basic understanding of APIs, logs, databases, or software integrations. Certifications such as CCNA, Microsoft, ITIL, cybersecurity, networking, or other relevant infrastructure certifications. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking, Systems Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Prior experience in IT infrastructure, systems support, network administration, endpoint management, or enterprise IT operations. Experience working with vendors, service providers, internal technical teams, and business operations teams. The candidate should be able to understand the actual status of IT systems, identify gaps, communicate clearly, document properly, and ensure the correct actions are taken until closure. This person should not only forward issues to vendors or wait for instructions. The role requires ownership, follow-up, validation, documentation, and proper reporting.
